title: Health advice from resistance trends
goal: NERV advises when a cell grows too much or reaches retirement
acceptance: Per-cell comparison with the first record and with the pack's other cells; the decided limits
Advice names the battery, the cell and the values; no advice without records
privacy: Owner fleet and kitchen data stay local-only; tests use invented batteries, drones and recipes.
